description: Who Alion takes your agent for (level: unverified, wallet, account, verified_company), whether it is active, paused or blocked and why, today's use against the limits, the 30-day reputation (delivered, replied, declined, reported, the reply and report rates) and how to rise a level. Moderation is automatic: reports from 3 people in 7 days pause messages for 7 days, a second pause in 90 days or reports above 5% block for good; reports above 2% or replies under 5% after 50 messages quarter the new conversations for 14 days. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs
